subject: phy-u-fund
title: (R)PHY.U.FUND.-----DYM.F.
description: Chart on book p. 498 (MP(II)-16). PHY-U-FUND (physical universe fundamental) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics), C-CONT (composite continuance) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From IF-ST-DY: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From C-CONT: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). From MT-INFO: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From VT-DY: INTR (interpretation).
